provenance.authoringMethod: mechanical Cartesian expansion of independently authored T1 realization seeds and pre-production V0 policy decisions

decisionPolicy.matrixScope: Cells cover non-slash static template, exact-degree, voice-count, doubling, and structural family applicability. Bass-policy variants, range, register-placement, low-register spacing, and Quartal-context feasibility are proved separately. A null matrix refusal means those static baseline laws pass; it does not guarantee success for every request-time range or bass variant.
decisionPolicy.literalRealizationRule: Each of the 33 T1 formula matrix seeds selects semantic realization ID literal.
decisionPolicy.alteredDominantRule: The four checked-in altered-dominant realization IDs remain distinct and fold only to quality class dominant-seventh.
decisionPolicy.adaptiveMinimumVoiceCount: The declared template minimum is authoritative and is never raised to the selected realization required-degree count.
decisionPolicy.adaptiveMaximumVoiceCount: For Balanced and Open, the maximum is the number of exact realization degrees plus at most one root doubling and at most one natural-fifth doubling, capped at seven; guide tones are not doubled. Drop-2 uses the stricter closed-source doubling rule below.
decisionPolicy.drop2ClosedSourceDoublingRule: When a Drop-2 voice count exceeds the selected realization's number of distinct exact degrees, it requires an octave copy. Any octave copy forces the closed source to span at least 12 semitones, exceeding the declared 11-semitone maximum, so the matrix refusal is constraints-unsatisfied with doubling-not-permitted.
decisionPolicy.drop2StaticStructureRule: For a filled Drop-2 cell, enumerate every cyclic inversion of the selected pitch classes as a unique ascending closed source spanning at most 11 semitones, lower the literal second-highest member by 12 semitones, and revalidate a final span of 12 through 36 semitones plus the seven-semitone adjacent-gap law only at counts 4 and 5. If no inversion passes, refuse with family-transform-invalid.
decisionPolicy.fixedTemplateMembership: Every fixed template degree must be an exact member of the selected realization; an absent degree yields template-degree-absent and is never fabricated.
decisionPolicy.fixedTemplateVoiceCount: A count below the fixed template minimum yields voice-count-below-template-minimum; every other undeclared count yields voice-count-unsupported.
decisionPolicy.quartalAvailability: Declared Quartal rows are context-gated at their declared counts without precomputing a compatible degree sequence. Request-time exact membership and 5-or-6-semitone adjacency validation may yield quartal-context-invalid. Repeated degrees are not pre-rejected by context validation; an undeclared repeat or octave copy is checked later as constraints-unsatisfied with doubling-not-permitted.
decisionPolicy.quartalCompatibilityClassLabels: The Lydian, Dorian, Mixolydian, suspended-modal, Locrian, and symmetric-diminished labels in family-templates.json are descriptive provenance. QuartalContext has no compatibility-class field, and V0 does not independently enforce those labels.
decisionPolicy.undeclaredRowRefusal: Missing Shell or Rootless rows yield quality-family-unsupported; missing Quartal rows yield quartal-row-undeclared.
decisionPolicy.adaptiveInsufficientSlotRule: For a template-supported adaptive count, form the distinct required-or-guide vector in selected-realization order. If voiceCount is shorter under this non-slash baseline, project the omitted suffix independently to required-degree-omitted and guide-tone-omitted in constraint order.

checksums.recordProjectionFormat: one compact JSON array per record in stored order, followed by LF
checksums.fixturePayloadProjection: one compact JSON object with recursively sorted keys and checksums removed, followed by LF
